title: LMPvisualizer for plotting and analyzing LAMMPS output
description:
A desktop application for interactively exploring LAMMPS molecular dynamics output: thermo logs, trajectory dumps, and domain-based displacement/strain analysis. Log mode plots thermo quantities, averages across systems, defines custom properties, and fits curves. Trajectory mode steps through dump frames as scatter plots with playback, filtering, and heatmap coloring. DSD mode implements the domain strain decomposition method, projecting particle displacements onto one axis inside configurable domains and differentiating them into strains.
Source code: https://github.com/LukasLaubert/LMPvisualizer
